- **observed-in-code and observed-in-tests**. A stale report can run expiry and notification before its outcome is discarded. A matching late report can still update counts after the caller leaves. Execute returns the request’s value and error to its calling worker after a skipped report. The worker channel and disposal of a queued value are supplied by the caller in the probe.
